source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to electromagnetic radiation (PDF 186-187).

blocks.text: Roshni (light) aur electromagnetic radiation ki doosri qismein waves (lehron) ki shakal mein safar karti hain. In waves mein electric aur magnetic fields thartharate (oscillate karte) hain. Har wave ki pehchan us ki wavelength (λ, lehar ki lambai) aur frequency (ν, aik second mein kitni lehrein guzarti hain) se hoti hai. Yeh sab roshni ki speed (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s) se chalti hain. In teenon ka rishta yeh hai:
Yahan λ wavelength hai (meters mein), ν frequency hai (Hertz ya s⁻¹ mein) aur c roshni ki speed hai (ms⁻¹ mein).
Electromagnetic spectrum mein kai qisam ki radiations shamil hain: radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light (nazar aane wali roshni), ultraviolet radiation, X-rays aur gamma rays.

blocks.alt: Aik ufuqi patti jo gamma ray, X-ray, ultra violet, patli visible patti, infrared, microwave aur radio frequency mein bati hai, baen taraf sab se zyada tawanai (highest energy) aur daen taraf sab se kam. Oopar wavelength ka paimana 10^-2 se 10^12 nm, daen taraf barhta; neeche frequency ka paimana 10^20 se 10^4 s^-1, baen taraf barhta. Visible patti neeche phaila kar 400 nm (banafshi) se 750 nm (surkh) tak rangeen patti ki shakal mein dikhai gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.1: Electromagnetic spectrum, wavelength, frequency, tawanai (energy) aur nazar aane wala hissa (kitab ki Figure 29.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure mein baen (left) taraf gamma rays hain: un ki wavelength sab se chhoti aur energy sab se zyada hai. Daen (right) taraf radio waves hain: wavelength sab se lambi aur energy sab se kam. Visible light sirf 400 se 750 nm ki patli si patti hai.
Planck ki quantum theory ke mutabiq:

items: Atoms aur molecules energy sirf khaas, alag alag miqdar (discrete amounts) mein chhorte ya jazb (absorb) karte hain. Electromagnetic radiation ki sab se chhoti miqdar jo chhori ya jazb ho sakti hai, quantum energy kehlati hai.
Radiation ki frequency aur us mein maujood energy directly proportional hain (aik barhe to doosri bhi usi hisaab se barhti hai).

blocks.text: Radiation ki energy is tarah likhi jati hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Units dekhein: h ka unit J.s, c ka m/s aur λ ka m hai. In ko is formula mein rakhein to E ka unit J (joule) aata hai. Is liye wavelength jitni chhoti, energy utni zyada.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan E = hcν likhti hai aur saath cm⁻¹ unit deti hai. Lekin kitab mein ν frequency ka nishan hai, aur frequency ke saath formula E = hν hai. Jis formula mein c bhi ho, us mein ν̄ (wavenumber, yani 1/λ, cm⁻¹ mein) aata hai: E = hcν̄.

blocks.prompt: Fi photon kis ki energy zyada hai, ultraviolet ya infrared? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ultraviolet ki. Us ki wavelength chhoti aur frequency zyada hai, aur E = hν = hc/λ, is liye chhoti wavelength par energy zyada hoti hai.

items: c = λν: wavelength aur frequency ka rishta.
E = hν = hc/λ: chhoti wavelength yani zyada frequency aur zyada energy.
